fields.description: API base URL for LTL requests. Defaults to ShipEngine if empty.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Standard Carrier Alpha Code (SCAC) for this LTL carrier. Used in BOL generation and tracking.
fields.label: LTL Carrier SCAC

fields.description: When enabled, submitting an accepted Shipment Quotation automatically creates a Purchase Invoice or Journal Entry for freight expense recognition. Disable to perform manual reconciliation.
fields.label: Auto-Create Accounting Entry

fields.description: Item used on Purchase Invoices and Journal Entries created when a Shipment Quotation is accepted.
fields.label: Freight Item

fields.description: Debit account for freight cost when the company absorbs the expense (prepaid, no customer chargeback). Falls back to the Freight Item's default expense account.
fields.label: Freight Expense Account

fields.description: Clearing account used for both Collect Purchase Invoices and prepaid chargeback Journal Entries. Must be an Asset account with blank account_type to allow GL posting without party requirement.
fields.label: Freight Clearing Account

fields.description: ShipEngine: Api-Key. Banyan: optional static Bearer only if the carrier issues a token; when set, overrides Client ID/Secret OAuth for Banyan.
fields.label: LTL API Key

fields.description: Banyan: OAuth client_id (client_credentials). ODFL: API username. WWEX: use Connected App, not this field.
fields.label: Client ID

fields.description: Banyan: OAuth client_secret. ODFL: API password. WWEX: use Connected App, not this field.
fields.label: Client Secret

fields.description: Shipper account number with the provider (WWEX account#, ODFL bill-to account code, Banyan clientRefNumber). Not used for ShipEngine.
fields.label: Account Number

fields.description: Banyan only: use the /shipments/ezrate endpoint (zip-to-zip rating) instead of the full /shipments endpoint. Useful when full address validation is not required.
fields.label: Use EZ Rate (Banyan)
